project: Golden Retina realistic 3D eye-finding and tracking AI
scope: Build from scratch: a parameterized 3D human face and anatomically informed eye renderer with aligned segmentation/landmark labels, then train, evaluate, and package a full-frame eye-tracking pipeline. No motor commands; synthetic-only until checked against real camera recordings.
current_status: Closeout complete: frozen shared-eye model, fresh synthetic evaluation, baseline comparisons, loopback research API smoke check, local artifact integrity verification, and Golden Retina L4 shutdown verified. Synthetic-only evidence; one base identity; no real-camera/human validation.
gpu_status: Golden Retina L4 stopped · closeout complete
hardware_status: No target camera hardware or device-domain eye frames currently available; all v2 evidence is synthetic.
compute_recommendation: Google Cloud L4 selected for this authorized sprint; RTX remains unused

execution_sprint.estimate_basis: Live estimate = elapsed dedicated Golden Retina VM runtime × ₺35.47/hour; excludes possible storage/network/tax and delayed final billing. ₺1,980 hard cap.
execution_sprint.scope: Fresh 3D-rendered synthetic human-face and eye-tracking pipeline from scratch; training/validation/test and inference; no physical-camera validation
execution_sprint.current_task: Complete. Dedicated Golden Retina L4 instance is TERMINATED; local tracker remains available.
execution_sprint.latest_render_progress: Frozen v2 baseline audit and loopback inference service completed; no further GPU training is indicated.

budget.status: ₺1,900 planned + ₺80 protected overhead = ₺1,980 hard ceiling. VM stopped at 2026-11-10T00:31:44Z; runtime estimate at shutdown ₺204.63. Final settled billing may differ; storage/network/tax may be separate.

gates.title: Real-person representativeness not demonstrated
gates.detail: Only generated subjects are present. No real-person or camera recordings have been supplied; synthetic held-out scores cannot establish deployed tracking performance.

gates.title: Photorealistic face appearance not achieved
gates.detail: Visual audit of 12 evenly spaced samples from the procedural generator showed mannequin-like faces, simplistic hair caps, and inconsistent eye geometry. Generation stopped at 780/1,620; partial outputs are preserved and excluded from training. CC0 Vitruvian + Bob hair is a better morphable base, but still a synthetic render. Material-index eye labels and meaningful subject variation must pass before regeneration.

gates.title: 3D render acceleration and pipeline smoke
gates.detail: Blender 4.5.11 renders at 512×512 on the L4 and the trainer smoke-run completes; these establish pipeline wiring only. Full-scale renderer output failed visual realism review and was stopped at 780/1,620; partial data are preserved as a non-training baseline.

gates.title: Closed-eye pupil/glint labels
gates.detail: On two seeded closed-eye checks, pupil and glint labels are absent. Small iris/sclera remnants remain at eyelid edges; treat closed-eye appearance as approximate.

gates.title: Spend ceiling
gates.detail: ₺1,900 planned plus ₺80 protected overhead = ₺1,980 hard ceiling. Runtime estimate uses elapsed L4 time at the configured hourly rate; final settled billing may differ.

gates.title: Stylized renderer failed visual review
gates.detail: A contact sheet of 12 samples from the active generator showed mannequin-like faces and inconsistent eye appearance. The 780-frame partial output is preserved but excluded from training; switch to an asset-based generator only after ground-truth eye labels and appearance variation are verified.

blocks.name: Build parameterized 3D face and eye geometry
blocks.detail: Create an original 3D head with age presentation, face proportions, skin tone/texture, brows/hair, and detailed eyes: sclera, iris, dilating pupil, cornea, eyelids/blink, tear line, and corneal glints.
blocks.evidence: L4 512×512 full-face render passes visual presence check for both eyes; scale invariant prevents oversized eye highlight. Procedural appearance still needs realism refinement and real-camera representativeness is unverified.
blocks.status_label: Complete · parameterized face and eye geometry rendered

blocks.name: Implement beauty render and ground-truth label passes
blocks.detail: Emit visible-light and IR-like frames plus aligned face/eye/iris/pupil/glint/landmark masks and gaze metadata; verify occlusion labels.
blocks.evidence: L4 compositor writes raw IndexOB EXR; one 512×512 debug mask contains all classes 0–11. Multi-seed/occlusion audit remains in block 4.
blocks.status_label: Complete · beauty and 12-class label export smoke-tested

blocks.name: Add subject and capture-condition parameter ranges
blocks.detail: Vary age presentation from child to older adult, feminine/masculine facial morphology, continuous skin pigmentation, face geometry, eye geometry, gaze, blink, pose, camera, focus, exposure, and illumination.
blocks.evidence: 12-frame 512×512 seeded audit covered 12 unique subjects and varied age groups, pigmentation, visible/IR-like appearance, camera pose, gaze and focus. Landmark projection and exposure/DOF wiring are present. This is variation coverage, not proof of demographic representativeness.
blocks.status_label: Complete · subject and capture variation audited

blocks.name: Render initial 3D sample set and visually audit
blocks.detail: Render diverse samples; inspect full face and enlarged eye crops, labels, glints, blinks, and edge cases before scaling data.
blocks.evidence: QA5 contact sheet inspected; the 12-subject audit passes disjoint splits, all class IDs 0–11, no duplicate images, valid open-pupil labels, zero pupil/glint mask pixels on both blink eyes, and mean projected-landmark-to-mask center error 0.70 px (p95 0.82). Synthetic QA only.
blocks.status_label: Complete · full-frame and blink labels visually checked

blocks.name: Generate subject-disjoint train/validation/test dataset
blocks.detail: Render deterministic split populations with no subject parameter/seed overlap; persist images, labels, manifest, and renderer settings.
blocks.evidence: 64/64 rendered at 512×512; renderer audit PASS; dataset preparation accepted 64/64, rejected 0. Deterministic split 45/10/9 across morph seeds of one base mesh; not independent subjects.

blocks.name: Build the fresh 3D-label trainer and resume pipeline
blocks.detail: Train full-frame segmentation/localization with atomic latest/best checkpoints, per-epoch logs, validation-only early stopping, and resumable state.
blocks.evidence: Five-class full-frame U-Net trainer and preprocessing scripts syntax-checked locally and remotely; CUDA available. Validation-only checkpoint selection and explicit post-freeze test path are implemented.
blocks.status_label: Complete · five-class trainer and resume outputs prepared

blocks.name: Train and tune using train/validation only
blocks.detail: Train the new model on 3D-rendered frames; inspect class, pupil/glint, and failure metrics; materially change the approach if learning stalls.
blocks.evidence: V1 five-class failure preserved (validation Dice .557; exposed diagnostic test .542; left pupil 0/9). V2 shares iris/pupil labels, trained 28 epochs with best epoch 24; validation macro Dice .8532, pupil pixel presence 10/10 per side, mean center error 0.34/0.41 px at 384 input. Synthetic single-base result.
blocks.status_label: Complete · shared semantic classes fixed pupil asymmetry

blocks.name: Freeze model, renderer, and configuration
blocks.detail: Hash weights, split manifest, renderer code/parameters, class map, and preprocessing before test evaluation.
blocks.evidence: Frozen checkpoint SHA-256 57ef89060125078d9aea7f3f8a21b380a269b3f34b20ef89d7ed32872262c2ab; selected epoch 24 using validation foreground macro Dice only. Fresh evaluation seed 816170 was not used for selection.
blocks.status_label: Complete · model/config frozen before fresh-seed run

blocks.name: Run locked synthetic test once
blocks.detail: Report eye detection, pupil/glint localization, segmentation, gaze-coordinate error, blink/occlusion handling, and condition-stratified uncertainty.
blocks.evidence: 24/24 fresh morph seeds evaluated without selection use; macro Dice 0.854 (iris .809, pupil .900); pupil pixel-presence 24/24 each side; mean center error .434/.539 px at 384 input; checkpoint SHA 57ef89060125078d9aea7f3f8a21b380a269b3f34b20ef89d7ed32872262c2ab. One synthetic base identity.
blocks.status_label: Complete · frozen checkpoint fresh-seed synthetic evaluation

blocks.name: Run full-frame inference and temporal tracking
blocks.detail: Exercise images and generated sequences through the same interface; measure tracking continuity and reacquisition after blinks.
blocks.evidence: 32/32 translated-label frames detected on each side; raw mean center error 1.220/1.048 model-input px, filtered 1.195/1.036 px. Sequence is fixed face/camera and one mesh; not physical gaze or camera validation.
blocks.status_label: Complete · frozen model plus temporal filter sequence smoke

blocks.name: Stress and baseline comparisons
blocks.detail: Compare against classical image processing on identical frames; test pose, lighting, focus, skin, eye shape, and IR-like conditions.
blocks.evidence: Against a train-only constant-coordinate baseline: fresh 24-seed mean center error fell 78.76% (left) / 74.07% (right); on a 32-frame translated-geometry sequence it fell 60.50% / 67.36%. Frozen candidate also passed a local loopback API smoke check. These are same-renderer, one-base-mesh synthetic comparisons only.
blocks.status_label: Complete · coordinate-prior comparison and inference interface verified

blocks.name: Package, pull, document, and close L4
blocks.detail: Pull checksummed source/results, write model/data card, update tracker, verify spend, and stop only the dedicated VM within the existing safety window.
blocks.evidence: Closeout archive SHA-256 a320845fb49dc5e1ab38053f67732a02ec24e932ef80ca1935e220f1997bc423 verified locally. Frozen checkpoint hash agrees across run card, evaluation, and summary. golden-retina-l4-01 verified TERMINATED; no other VM is listed in the Golden Retina project. Runtime estimate at stop ₺204.63, not a settled invoice.
blocks.status_label: Complete · package verified and Golden Retina L4 stopped

activity_log.text: Visual contact-sheet audit rejected the procedural generator: 12 samples were mannequin-like with inconsistent eye appearance. Stopped at 780/1,620; partial output/logs are preserved as a failed baseline and excluded from training. Pivoting to CC0 Vitruvian mesh with Bob hair; must verify eye-material masks and variation before generating training data. Estimated spend ~₺112.7 / ₺1,980 cap.

CC0 CharMorph/Vitruvian portrait probe PASS: imported 37,436-vertex mesh with 153 shape keys, added Bob hairstyle, and rendered face with visible eye materials. Visual inspection: more detailed than procedural bust, still synthetic studio-asset appearance; not used in active training dataset. Main render at 740/1,620. Runtime estimate ~₺110.9 / ₺1,980 cap.

Portrait probe first attempt exited before rendering: incorrect CharMorph library import path. Fixed the import to the add-on’s actual charlib module and restarted the isolated probe; the 1,620-frame main render was not modified.
Live L4 render reached 700/1,620 (~12.6/min). CharMorph portrait probe with CC0 hair/framing changes is active separately. Estimated runtime spend ~₺108.6 / ₺1,980 cap.

Render checkpoint: log-confirmed generation reached 620/1,620 at ~12.6/min. Raw output folder count is 633 because it already contained 13 smoke images; tracker now reports the authoritative generation count. Runtime estimate ~₺105.3 / ₺1,980 cap.

Live L4: 593/1,620 synthetic image files present; generation log at 580 and continuing (~12.6/min). Runtime estimate ₺104.0 against revised ₺1,980 cap (₺1,900 planned + ₺80 reserve). Visual CharMorph/Vitruvian probe confirmed textured morphable face and eye materials; still studio-like synthetic rendering, not integrated.

Live L4 checkpoint: 504/1,620 synthetic frames rendered (~12.6/min). Runtime-based spend estimate ₺99.4/₺1,900. CC0 morphable-face material/import route under visual feasibility check; no pass claim yet.
Live L4 render checkpoint: 224/1,620 frames at 12.6/min. Runtime-based spend estimate ₺86.4 of ₺1,900.
Live L4 status: 160/1,620 synthetic frames rendered at 12.6/min; runtime-based spend estimate ₺83.7 of ₺1,900 cap (₺1,820 planned + ₺80 reserve).

QA5 12-subject dataset audit PASS: no train/validation/test subject overlap, no duplicate images, all 12 mask classes present, zero pupil/glint labels on 2 blink eyes, no missing open-eye pupil labels; mean landmark-mask center error 0.70 px, p95 0.82 px. These are renderer QA metrics, not learned-model metrics.
Full L4 render reached 120/1,620 subjects at 12.5 frames/min; generated data remain on the VM until the full run and training complete.
L4 full dataset render started. Initial throughput measured at 12.4 subjects/min for the first 40; 1,620 total planned. Rendering has not finished and no training metrics exist yet.

Geometry QA5 passed key blink invariants: both checked closed eyes have zero pupil and zero glint mask pixels. A corrected iris/cornea/lid depth stack is included; the 12-frame contact sheet was visually reviewed.

Added RGB 12-class full-frame U-Net trainer with train-only augmentation, validation checkpoint selection, patient/subject split audit, locked test metrics, per-eye pupil localization, blink false-positive reporting, single-frame inference and alpha-beta temporal tracking.
Budget raised to ₺1,820 planned + ₺80 protected overhead = ₺1,900 hard ceiling.
Wired exposure/DOF and textured-material IR-like grayscale into the renderer; shortened oversized lashes and refined nose/eyebrow/skin/hair detail. Re-rendering 12-frame QA.
Budget updated: ₺1,820 planned + ₺80 protected overhead reserve = ₺1,900 absolute ceiling.
L4 inspection found and fixed a right-eye highlight that had retained unit scale and occluded the face. Added a runtime geometry invariant.
L4 one-frame 512×512 face render and compositor EXR object-index mask verified; all 12 class IDs 0–11 appeared. Contact-sheet audit still required.
Blender 4.5 render-pass API was unavailable through the expected in-memory collection; mask export now routes IndexOB through compositor to float EXR.
Official Blender 4.5.11 LTS detected the dedicated L4 through OptiX. A first beauty render took about 9 seconds including startup; warmed dataset throughput remains unmeasured.

Four-case CharMorph eye-label audit PASS: transparent-cornea pass exposed iris masks (1,739–2,289 pixels) and pupil masks (221–274 pixels) at 768×768. Single synthetic identity; no training or real-camera validation. Budget changed to ₺1,900 planned + ₺80 reserve = ₺1,980 hard cap; runtime estimate ~₺135 at configured rate.

V6 seed-driven probe completed: 8 color frames at 768x768; per-eye audit PASS for iris/pupil regions and pupil-inside-iris geometry. Four sub-20px iris edge specks reported; raw masks unchanged. Runtime cost estimate about ₺149.74; approved budget ₺1,900 planned + ₺80 protected reserve = ₺1,980 hard ceiling. Next: bounded age/gender morph label-retention probe; still one base identity.
Budget updated: ₺1,900 planned + ₺80 protected reserve = ₺1,980 hard cap. Runtime estimate at checkpoint: ₺168.20; excludes possible storage/network/tax.
V9 (5/5) and V10 (7/7) paired iris/pupil geometry audits PASS with dynamic camera reframe. V7/V8 crop failures excluded. Started 64-case 512×512 seeded render cohort; training not yet started.
64-case CharMorph cohort rendered and passed label-presence audit. Preprocessing accepted 64/64 and split 45/10/9 by sample seed; one base identity, no subject generalization.
Started five-class full-frame U-Net training on dedicated L4. Best checkpoint selected by validation macro Dice; held-out morph-seed test runs only after selection.
Candidate v1 5-class UNet diagnostic: validation macro Dice 0.557, exposed held-out morph-seed macro Dice 0.542; left pupil presence 0/9 and right pupil 9/9. Marked test exposed and not confirmatory.
Started candidate v2 on the same training/validation split: shared iris/pupil semantic classes and per-eye image-half localization to test the observed left/right pupil-class asymmetry.

Candidate v2 shared-eye semantic model selected and frozen at epoch 24 using validation macro Dice only: 0.8532; validation pupil presence 10/10 per side, mean center error 0.34/0.41 px at 384 input. Checkpoint and manifest hashes written to frozen run card. Fresh-seed synthetic evaluation started.

Frozen shared-eye candidate fresh-seed evaluation PASS on 24/24 cases: macro Dice .854 (iris .809, pupil .900), pupil pixel-presence 24/24 each side, center error means .434/.539 pixels at 384 input; no rejected samples. Same single synthetic base identity.

Frozen candidate controlled 32-frame synthetic sequence: pupil detection coverage 32/32 per side; mean center error 1.220/1.048 model-input px raw and 1.195/1.036 px after alpha-beta tracking. Fixed face/camera; translation labels only.

Frozen v2 reduced mean center error versus a train-only constant-coordinate baseline by 78.76%/74.07% on fresh seeds and 60.50%/67.36% on the translated synthetic sequence. Added shared-eye CLI and loopback-only API; local CPU GET /health and POST /v1/frame smoke check passed with both eyes returned. Synthetic single-base limitations remain.
Budget set to ₺1,900 planned + ₺80 protected overhead = ₺1,980 hard ceiling. Runtime-based VM estimate at update: ₺203.19; excludes possible disk/network/tax and billing lag.

Final closeout: frozen v2 checkpoint and transferred archive verified; model-versus-coordinate baseline report and loopback API smoke record saved locally. Dedicated VM golden-retina-l4-01 is TERMINATED. Estimated compute runtime spend at stop: ₺204.63, not final billing.

legacy_results.status: Synthetic-only evaluation; not real-eye or camera performance. Validation collapsed at epoch 11, so the epoch-10 best-validation checkpoint was kept.
